scenario: [LGRA.10.3.7]: a `cache` key is a `STRING_LIT` with no interpolation site ([LGRA.2.9.6]), so a key with one is refused with DS_VALIDATE_DYNAMIC_IDENT_KWARG. Rule `r` writes `cache key: "k.{s.id}" value: 1`. The same key is also refused as an inert interpolation, DS_VALIDATE_INTERP_INERT_POSITION, because `cache` is not a verb [LGRA.2.9.6.8] makes eligible (LGRA.2.9.6.8.inert_cache_key pins that code); this vector pins the second code. PATH PINNED: dsc.validate's `lgra_10_3_7_cache_key` on a `cache`, through `cache_key_arg`, whose `lgra_10_3_7_string_lit` fails on an `ex_string` in which `has_site` finds a site.

schema Src scope logical:
    id: String key

rule r:
    Src s
->
    cache key: "k.{s.id}" value: 1
